items.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 define H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n)∈D^(Fin(n+1)), Y_n(w)_k=w_(n+k), and F_n=σ(w↦w_k:k<n). Then H_n and Y_n are measurable for the ambient product Borel structures. If w,w′ agree for all k<n, then H_n(w)=H_n(w′), for all real sequences w,w′, including the ambient extension. Moreover H_n is F_n-measurable. The entire countable unused raw tail has law (Y_n)_*P=P and is independent of H_n. Its joint law is (H_n,Y_n)_*P=(H_n)_*P⊗P. For every measurable A⊆D^(Fin(n+1)), (Y_n)_*(P restricted to H_n⁻¹(A))=P(H_n⁻¹(A))·P. All conclusions hold for every y,r,z₀,n with the standing analytic parameters fixed. The last identity is unnormalized and includes P(H_n⁻¹(A))=0; no division by a point-history probability or regular conditional distribution is claimed. At n=0 the history is constant and Y₀ is the identity. Tagged stopped histories are retained without assigning a phase at infinity. The tail starts at raw coordinate n, which represents the source E_(n+1). No measurability, causality, independence or law provider is assumed. This is an attributed ASTIS completion of the deterministic-depth unused-input probability bridge implicit in AppendixA.1(A.7), using the authors actual recursion and independent clock model. Conditional random-hazard next-wait survival, conditional finite-event densities/final survival/iteration, full(A.7), physical-time residual memorylessness, random stopping/restart/Markovness, reversal, invariance, all-L² contraction, implementation error/cost, main results and actual-input composition remain separate obligations.
assumptions: E is finite-dimensional over ℝ with inner product and Borel measurable structure; rank zero is included. V:E→ℝ is C².
The six analytic hypotheses are α>0, α≤β, V∈C², the pointwise α/β Hessian bounds for every x,v, η>0, and βη≤1. α,β are nonnegative.
y,r,z₀ and n are deterministic and universally quantified. No random initial state or stopping index is included.
P, ε, all eight actual recursion definitions, H_n,Y_n and F_n are literal definitions. Measurability, prefix causality, independence and distributional identities are conclusions.
A is any Borel history event, with no positive-probability assumption. The restricted law is unnormalized. Zero rates, zero normals, infinite waits and stopped branches are allowed.
